stations.title: Rhona
stations.say: Why does it say my name?

stations.title: Pager and rota
stations.text: Every exercise urgent, one leader for ever.

captions: Back at the base, Rhona reads the pages and the rota for the week ahead.
Today exercises go out as urgent, the rota names the wrong leader, and the ropes crash.
You give parameters defaults, name values in calls, and fix where names live.
Now each page, each night's leader and the rope count come out right.
Defaults, named arguments, and names that live inside a function.
